name: T-Drones VA23
description: lift+cruise quadplane, 4 lift rotors + pusher, 10.0 kg MTOW, 2.5 kg max payload. Parameters derived from published data; see provenance.

provenance.wind_rating_beaufort: referenced — level 5 wind resistance. Beaufort 5 is a band; the limit is read at its lower edge
provenance.m_tow: derived — 12.5 kg MTOW minus 2.5 kg payload = 10.00 kg empty. RAPTOR adds payload on top of this, so the field holds the empty mass, not the MTOW
provenance.S_ref: derived — b^2/AR with b = 2.3 m (referenced) and AR = 8.0 (assumed), giving 0.661 m^2 and a mean chord of 0.287 m
provenance.AR: assumed — 8.0, read from the airframe's proportions; not published. Wing loading follows at 15.1 kg/m^2, which is the number to sanity-check
provenance.n_rotors: referenced — 4, from the published configuration (lift+cruise quadplane, 4 lift rotors + pusher)
provenance.rotor_diameter_m: assumed — 0.559 m (22 in), the usual size for this mass class; not published. Gives a disk loading of 10.2 kg/m^2 against the 5-15 kg/m^2 that multirotors of this class run
provenance.rotor_parking: referenced — aligned — follows from the configuration, not a free choice
provenance.cell_chemistry: referenced — li-ion — from the pack the manufacturer specifies
provenance.cell_capacity_ah: assumed — 4.2 Ah — the manufacturer does not say which cell the pack is built from, so a Molicel INR21700-P42A is assumed. It implies 5.2 parallel strings, which is what divides the pack's internal resistance
provenance.battery_mass: derived — 985 Wh at 195 Wh/kg pack level = 5.06 kg, which is 40% of the 12.5 kg MTOW. That is 4.40 kg of cells plus 15% for wiring, BMS and case
provenance.specific_energy: derived — 195 Wh/kg at pack level = 224 Wh/kg of cells divided by 1 + 0.15 of overhead
provenance.battery_capacity_mah: referenced — largest of 22/27/30 Ah that fits the mass budget — 22.0 Ah, giving 985 Wh at a 3.732 V measured mean cell open-circuit voltage
provenance.cell_internal_resistance_ohm: assumed — 25 mOhm DC for one Molicel INR21700-P42A. Over 12S5.2P that is 57 mOhm at the pack, which sets voltage sag at hover current. Measure it if the pack is in hand
provenance.eta_cruise: assumed — 0.72, a dedicated pusher propeller sized for cruise
provenance.eta_vtol: assumed — 0.62, motor x ESC x propeller in the hover working point
provenance.geometry.fuselage_diameter: derived — 0.252 m, from the 2.5 kg payload's bulk at a cold-chain packing density; not published
provenance.geometry.boom_length: assumed — 1.265 m, 55% of span — the rotors sit outboard of the fuselage but well inboard of the tips
provenance.geometry.tail_area: assumed — 0.0727 m^2, 11% of wing area (horizontal plus vertical), a conventional tail volume for this layout
